command: OTHMODE — DEPLOYMENT / ERP ACCESS DIAGNOSTIC: diagnose why https://erp.mythosprod.xyz returns 403, then apply the smallest safe fix

preflight.environment: Claude Code remote sandbox — no SSH/host access to the production VPS; outbound egress via agent proxy.

sections.status_center: UNREACHABLE — the agent egress gateway denies CONNECT to erp.mythosprod.xyz:443 (recentRelayFailures: connect_rejected 403). status/othmode.mythosprod.xyz also blocked. First-hand origin probe impossible from here.

execution.diagnosis: The 403 is INTENTIONAL, not a fault. Per docs/ERP_SECURITY_STATUS.md (Applied 2026-08-22, first-hand on-host measurement): the erp.mythosprod.xyz nginx vhost runs in STATIC PRESERVATION mode with 'allow 127.0.0.1; allow ::1; deny all;' — every non-loopback request returns 403 (measured: public iface 51.68.226.211 -> 403; localhost -> 200; all .php -> 404). Compounded by Blocker A: no public DNS A record exists (dig +short erp.mythosprod.xyz A -> empty), so the host is only reachable by direct IP / Host-header. The erp probe is absent from probes.json, consistent with no public go-live.
execution.classification: SERVER (deliberate nginx deny-all access control) + DNS (no A record). NOT application, NOT Cloudflare, NOT file/dir permissions, NOT a broken deployment.
execution.why_locked: The ERP's PHP write endpoints are unauthenticated and upload.php derives the stored file extension from the client-supplied filename -> unauthenticated RCE if served under a PHP-executing docroot. Static mode (PHP disabled + deny-all + no DNS) is the documented mitigation.

sections.problems: The requested fix (make erp.mythosprod.xyz publicly serve the ERP) is a GATED action that must NOT and CANNOT be performed here: (1) it requires removing the deny-all guard + adding public DNS + TLS — Level-3 production security + DNS ops, owner-approval-only (AGENTS.md §25.3/§15); (2) DEPLOYMENT.md §5 forbids public serving until four security remediations are done (auth on write endpoints, server-side upload extension allow-list, path/$docId sanitisation, no PHP execution in upload dirs) — none are done; (3) no host access from this sandbox (no SSH; egress proxy blocks the origin). Opening it would re-expose the documented RCE.
sections.changes: NONE to production or ERP code (per the order: do not change production config until cause identified; the safe fix here is no change). No placeholder page, no blind redeploy.
sections.deployment: Deployed content (per DEPLOYMENT.md) is a COPY of the repo tree (index.html, js, css, assets, data, manifest) under /var/www/erp.mythosprod.xyz, PHP files deliberately excluded. Exact deployed commit not verifiable from this sandbox (no host access).
sections.outcome: Cause identified with first-hand on-host evidence: SERVER deny-all + DNS-absent, deliberate and security-gated. No safe autonomous fix exists in this environment. Path to public serving: owner DNS approval + the DEPLOYMENT.md §5 security remediations (chief: platform auth in front of write endpoints, the infra-gated item already tracked) + host access — all owner/infra actions.
sections.evolution: No Evolution capsule — a blocked read-only diagnostic does not qualify.
